property: Main home (prima casa) with two appurtenances
value: Not stated (Italian declarations do not report values)
detail: Owned outright (100%). The return for tax year 2024 lists the home and two appurtenances held for 9 days of 2024, and her Chamber declaration of 28 October 2025 and the Presidency's 2025 asset statement record the 'acquisto definitivo nuova abitazione come prima casa'. The 2024 return claims 3,047 EUR of mortgage interest on the main home; Open, citing registry documents, reported a 200,000 EUR 15-year mortgage taken out on 23 December 2024 and transferred to another bank in June 2025.
